statement: Unauthenticated POST /items with a JSON body returns 401 (not 2xx).
Authenticated POST /items with {"name":"demo"} and Bearer hello-demo-token returns 201 with string id and name equal to demo.
GET /items/:id for the created id returns 200 with the same name.
README documents how to run Track A vs Track B in ≤10 minutes.
CI runs unit tests and fails if scripts/oracle.sh content hash ≠ pinned hash in .github/oracle.sha256.
